title: Trace Snapshot Fanout & PagerDuty-lite Escalation Adapter for Low-noise Alerts
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: We get noisy PD pages for transient latency spikes where the signal is incomplete; responders often lack compact trace evidence and must manually collect spans. Goal: introduce a lightweight escalation adapter that (1) fans out a compact trace 'snapshot envelope' to downstream channels, (2) supports a PagerDuty-lite path (non-page notifications that still allow ack/escalate), and (3) implements dedup/memoization to reduce duplicate escalations during short-lived flaps.

Scope: produce a new service that subscribes to observability alerts (alert bus -> routing), synthesizes a structured trace snapshot (top spans, top N span tags, latency histograms, implicated endpoints), and delivers a single payload to PD, Slack, and the Incident Evidence Store. The adapter will include:
- Snapshot serializer (JSON schema v1) with redaction rules and size limit (<= 128KB)
- SLO-aware suppression window logic to avoid paging for bursts under configured thresholds
- Dedup cache keyed by alert fingerprint + short KV TTL (default 5m)
- Backfill link generator to the full trace on the tracing UI and a pre-rendered condensed timeline for Slack attachments

Success criteria: reduce duplicate P1 pages for the same root cause by >= 60% during 5m windows; median MTTR for traced escalations improves by 20%; no increase in overall missed Sev1s.

Compatibility & security: adapter must honor PII redaction rules (see confluence doc) and KMS keys for signing payloads to PD. It should be configurable per-customer for Dedicated/Private deployments (feature flags and policy layer).

Rollout plan: internal beta with oncall team -> opt-in teams -> gradual default enablement for low-noise alert classes. Include opt-out by route.

Implementation notes: will use existing alert router webhook as source (alerts->kafka topic). Snapshot generation will reuse trace sampling heuristics from trace-aggregator service. Deliverers: PD integration via Events API v2 with dedup token; Slack via message blocks with condensed timeline. Evidence store will be S3-backed with short TTL tags for auto-expiry.

Open questions: default dedup TTL; size/verbosity knobs exposed in Console; quick rollback path if suppression incorrectly masks real incidents.
